audio.text: Seven.

q: Which number do you hear?

audio.text: Good morning.

q: What do you hear?

audio.text: Thank you.

q: What do you hear?

audio.text: A big tree.

q: What do you hear?

audio.text: Ten.

q: Which number do you hear?

audio.text: Sit down, please.

q: What should you do?

audio.text: A new bag.

q: What do you hear?

audio.text: This is my bed.

q: What is it?

audio.text: Look at the moon!

q: What can you see?

audio.text: I like milk.

q: What does the woman like?

audio.text: Nice to meet you.

q: What do you hear?

audio.text: I have a dog.

q: What does the woman have?

audio.text: Yellow.

q: What do you hear?

audio.text: Happy birthday!

q: What do you hear?

audio.text: I am sorry.

q: What do you hear?

audio.text: The car is here.

q: What is here?

audio.text: Look at my nose.

q: What should you look at?

audio.text: Rice, please.

q: What does the woman want?

audio.text: I get up at seven. I go to work at eight.

q: When does the woman go to work?

audio.text: My sister has a dog, but I have a cat.

q: What pet does the man have?

audio.text: The book is under the chair, not on the table.

q: Where is the book?

audio.text: Omar doesn't like bananas. He eats an apple every day.

q: What does Omar eat every day?

audio.text: Today is Monday. The music class is tomorrow.

q: When is the music class?

audio.text: It is not raining now, but it is very cold. Wear your coat.

q: What is the weather like now?

audio.text: I don't have my bike today. Let's go swimming.

q: What does the woman want to do?

audio.text: There are ten boys and twelve girls in my class.

q: How many girls are in the class?

audio.text: My father is a cook. My mother is a teacher.

q: What is the mother's job?

audio.text: The shop is open from Monday to Saturday. It is closed on Sunday.

q: When is the shop closed?

audio.text: My bag is old. I want a new one.

q: What does the woman want?

audio.text: I have lunch at home and dinner at work.

q: Where does the man have dinner?

audio.text: Excuse me, where is the library?
It's next to the park.

q: Where is the library?

audio.text: I don't like tea. I drink water every morning.

q: What does the man drink in the morning?

audio.text: We play basketball on Saturday. On Sunday we go to the beach.

q: What do they do on Sunday?

audio.text: The bus is late again. Let's walk to work.

q: How will they get to work?

audio.text: Please close your books and listen to me.

q: What should the students do now?

qGloss.zh: 学生们现在应该做什么？

audio.text: Dad is in the kitchen. He is making dinner.

q: What is Dad doing?

audio.text: Did you go to the beach on Saturday?
No, it rained all day, so we stayed at home and watched a film.

q: What did the man do on Saturday?

audio.text: Excuse me, how do I get to the post office?
Go straight and turn left at the bank. It's across from the school.

q: Where is the post office?

audio.text: Attention, please. The ten o'clock train to Greenfield is twenty minutes late. It will leave from platform two, not platform five.

q: Where should people wait for the train?

qGloss.zh: 乘客应该在哪里等火车？

audio.text: I'm going to buy the blue jacket. It's cheaper than the black one.
But the black one is warmer.
I know, but I don't have enough money for it.

q: Why does the woman choose the blue jacket?

qGloss.zh: 女士为什么选蓝色的夹克？

audio.text: What are you going to do this weekend?
I wanted to visit my grandmother, but she's coming to our house instead. So I'll help my mother cook.

q: What will the woman do this weekend?

qGloss.zh: 女士这个周末要做什么？

audio.text: Can I borrow your pen? I left mine at home.
Sure, but please give it back after class. It was a present from my aunt.

q: What does the man ask the woman to do?
opts: Give the pen to his aunt

audio.text: Welcome to the City Zoo. This afternoon's bird show is going to start at two o'clock near the lake. Please remember that visitors must not feed the animals.

q: What can visitors do at two o'clock?

qGloss.zh: 游客两点钟可以做什么？

audio.text: You look tired today.
I am. The dog next door barked all night, and I couldn't sleep.

q: Why is the woman tired?
opts: She walked her dog all night

audio.text: Should we eat inside or outside today?
It's a little windy, but the kitchen is so hot. Let's take our plates out to the garden.

q: Where will they eat?

audio.text: How was your trip?
The hotel was small and the food was not very good, but the people were really friendly. I want to go again.

q: What did the woman like about her trip?

qGloss.zh: 女士喜欢这次旅行的哪一点？

audio.text: I can't find my keys. I looked in my bag and on the table.
Did you check your coat pocket?
Oh, here they are! Thank you.

q: Where were the keys?

audio.text: Hi Sam, it's Mia. The film starts at seven, so let's meet at six thirty in front of the cinema. Don't be late!

q: What time should Sam be at the cinema?

qGloss.zh: Sam 应该几点到电影院？

audio.text: Are you ready to order?
Yes, the chicken soup, please. Oh, wait. Does it have onions in it?
Yes, it does.
Then I'll have the tomato soup.

q: What will the woman eat?

audio.text: Your English is much better than last year.
Thanks. I didn't take any classes. I just listened to English songs every day and learned the words.

q: How did the man get better at English?

qGloss.zh: 男士的英语是怎么进步的？

audio.text: The language test was harder than I thought.
Really? I thought it was easier than the last one.

q: What does the woman think about the test?

qGloss.zh: 女士觉得这次考试怎么样？

opts: It was the same as the last one
It was longer than the last one
It was harder than the last one
It was easier than the last one

audio.text: Tomorrow we have a school trip to the lake. All students should come to the front gate at eight thirty. Please bring a hat and a bottle of water.

q: What should students bring tomorrow?

qGloss.zh: 学生们明天应该带什么？

audio.text: Hello, two tickets for the three o'clock show, please.
Sorry, that show is full. We have seats for five o'clock.
OK, two for five o'clock, then.

q: Which show will the woman see?

audio.text: Why didn't you call me last night?
I'm sorry. My phone had no battery left, and I couldn't find the charger.

q: Why didn't the woman call?

qGloss.zh: 女士为什么没有打电话？

opts: She could not use her phone

audio.text: Have you finished the report yet?
Almost. Everything has been written, but I haven't checked the numbers yet. If I find any mistakes, I'll have to stay late.

q: What is the man's next job?

audio.text: I've been thinking about selling my car.
Really? But you drive to work every day.
Not since the new train line opened. It's quicker, and I can read on the way.

q: Why might the man sell his car?

qGloss.zh: 男士为什么可能把车卖掉？

opts: He has no time to read

audio.text: The library will close one hour earlier today because the heating is being repaired. Books that are due today can be returned tomorrow without a fine.

q: What does the announcement say about books due today?

qGloss.zh: 关于今天到期的书，通知是怎么说的？

opts: They will be repaired by tomorrow
They cannot be borrowed until tomorrow
They must be returned within an hour
They can be returned a day late for free

audio.text: How did the interview go?
They said they'd call me by Friday. I answered all their questions, but I'm sorry I didn't ask more about the team.

q: What does the man regret?

audio.text: If it rains on Sunday, should we cancel the picnic?
I'd rather not. If we held it at my place instead, there would be plenty of room for everyone.

q: What does the woman suggest doing if it rains?

qGloss.zh: 女士建议下雨的话怎么办？

opts: Having the picnic at her home
Moving the picnic to another day

audio.text: This is the third time this month the printer has broken down.
I know. It would be cheaper to buy a new one than to keep paying for repairs.

q: What does the man think they should do?

qGloss.zh: 男士认为他们应该怎么做？

audio.text: Did you enjoy the book I lent you?
To be honest, I gave up after two chapters. The story was fine, but there were so many characters that I kept getting confused.

q: Why did the woman stop reading the book?

qGloss.zh: 女士为什么没把书读完？

opts: She had to give it back
She thought the book was too long
She could not follow who was who

audio.text: You're back early. Wasn't the concert good?
It was called off at the last minute because the singer's flight had been delayed. They've promised to hold it next week instead.

q: Why is the man home early?

qGloss.zh: 男士为什么这么早就回家了？

opts: The concert did not take place
He decided to leave before the end

audio.text: Hello, this is Dana from the bike shop. Your bike is ready, but we had to replace the back wheel as well as the brakes, so the price will be a little higher than we told you. We're open until six.

q: Why is Dana calling?

qGloss.zh: Dana 为什么打这个电话？

opts: To ask if she should replace the wheel
To say the bike needs more time
To say the shop will close early
To say the bike is ready but costs more

audio.text: I can't decide between the two rooms. The one near the station is smaller, but I'd save an hour every day. The other one has a garden.
Well, you've always said time matters more to you than space.

q: Which room does the woman think he should take?

qGloss.zh: 女士认为他应该选哪个房间？

audio.text: Why don't we ask Kenji to design the poster? He's really good at drawing.
He is, but he's already in charge of the music for the show. It isn't fair to give him more work.

q: Why does the man disagree?
opts: Kenji is not good at drawing
Kenji already has enough to do

audio.text: Excuse me, I bought this jacket yesterday, but one of the buttons is missing.
I'm sorry about that. Would you like your money back, or should I look for another one in your size?
Another one would be great, as long as it's exactly the same.

q: What does the man want?
opts: A jacket in a different size

audio.text: I heard the swimming pool will be closed for two months.
Yes, the roof is being replaced. Members have been given free passes to the pool in Westbrook until it reopens.

q: What have members received?

audio.text: You've lived in the city for ten years now. Do you ever miss the countryside?
I used to, especially the quiet. But now I'd find it hard to live without all the museums and markets.

q: How does the woman feel about the city now?

qGloss.zh: 女士现在对城市的感觉是怎样的？

opts: She still finds it too noisy
She has come to enjoy it
She wants to move away soon

audio.text: The meeting has been moved to Thursday, hasn't it?
That was the plan, but the manager is away on Thursday, so it's back to Wednesday at the same time.

q: When will the meeting be?

audio.text: If I were you, I'd take the earlier train. The later one arrives only ten minutes before the show starts.
Good point. I don't want to rush.

q: What will the woman probably do?
opts: Miss the start of the show

audio.text: Good afternoon, shoppers. A blue backpack was handed in at the information desk this morning. If you think it might be yours, please come and describe what is inside so that we can return it to you.

q: What must the owner do to get the backpack back?

qGloss.zh: 背包的主人要怎样才能拿回背包？

audio.text: I've just been told my talk has been cut from forty minutes to twenty.
That's hard. What will you leave out?
Probably the history part. The results are what people really want to hear.

q: What will the woman's shorter talk be about?

qGloss.zh: 女士缩短后的发言主要讲什么？

audio.text: So, how was the new restaurant everyone keeps talking about?
Well, the view from the terrace was lovely, and the waiters couldn't have been kinder.
And the food?
Let's just say I made myself a sandwich when I got home.

q: What does the woman suggest about the food?

qGloss.zh: 关于那里的饭菜，女士暗示了什么？

opts: It was too much to finish
It was the best part of the evening

audio.text: Jon assures me the designs will be ready by Monday.
He gave us the very same assurance about the last project, and they arrived two weeks behind schedule.

q: What does the man imply?

qGloss.zh: 男士的言外之意是什么？

opts: Jon may not keep his promise
Jon finished the last project early
Monday is too soon to need them

audio.text: The lights are off and there's no car outside.
They can't have left already. The party doesn't finish until ten. They must be in the garden at the back.

q: What does the woman believe?

qGloss.zh: 女士认为情况是怎样的？

opts: The hosts are still at home
The party is in another house
The hosts have gone out by car

audio.text: I've just found out that the museum lets people in for free after four o'clock. If I'd known, we wouldn't have paid full price at lunchtime yesterday.
Well, at least it wasn't crowded.

q: What do we learn about the woman?

qGloss.zh: 关于这位女士，我们知道了什么？

opts: She decided not to pay the full price
She found the museum far too crowded
She visited the museum after four o'clock
She paid when she could have gone in for free

audio.text: How did Priya take the news about the new schedule?
She told me she didn't mind at all. But she has asked three times whether it can be changed back.

q: What can we infer about Priya?

qGloss.zh: 关于 Priya，可以推断出什么？

opts: She asked for the new schedule
She has not heard the news yet
She is less happy than she claims
She has stopped caring about it

audio.text: I'm thinking of signing up for the advanced course.
You might want to sit in on a session before you commit. I signed up on impulse and spent the first month completely out of my depth.

q: What is the man's advice?

audio.text: Did the manager like your proposal?
She called it interesting and said she would bear it in mind, should a suitable opportunity ever come up.

q: What can be inferred from the manager's reply?

qGloss.zh: 从经理的答复中可以推断出什么？

opts: She is unlikely to use the proposal
She plans to use the proposal soon
She wants a few changes made first
She has not yet read the proposal

audio.text: You finished the whole puzzle in one evening? It took me a week!
To be fair, I can hardly take all the credit. By the time I sat down, my sister had already sorted the pieces by shape.

q: What is the man pointing out?
opts: His sister finished it for him
He is quicker than the woman
The puzzle was a small one
Part of the work was already done

audio.text: When the company moved its weekly meeting from Monday morning to Thursday afternoon, the managers expected complaints. What they got instead was shorter meetings: with the weekend approaching, nobody wanted to repeat a point that had already been made.

q: What happened after the meeting was moved?

qGloss.zh: 会议改时间以后发生了什么？

opts: It was moved back to Monday
Staff complained about the new time
People wasted less time in it

audio.text: I thought you were going to turn down that job offer.
I was on the verge of it, but then they offered to let me work remotely for most of the week, which put things in a rather different light.

q: Why did the woman accept the job?

qGloss.zh: 女士为什么接受了这份工作？

opts: She was offered a higher salary

audio.text: Should we tell Hiro that his presentation ran over time again?
I wouldn't. He was told twice last month, and it only made him more nervous. Better to put a clock where he can see it.

q: What does the man suggest?
opts: Helping Hiro keep track of the time

audio.text: The reviews said the film was a masterpiece.
The photography certainly was. As for the plot, I'm still waiting for someone to explain it to me.

q: What is the woman's opinion of the film?

qGloss.zh: 女士对这部电影的看法是什么？

opts: Too simple to hold her interest
Lovely to watch but hard to follow
A masterpiece from start to finish

audio.text: I ran into Leila yesterday. She's looking for a place near the river.
Near the river? Last year she told me she would never be able to afford anything there. They must have given her that promotion, then.

q: What does the man conclude?
opts: Leila is moving out of town
Leila has grown tired of the river

audio.text: We would have caught the earlier ferry if you hadn't stopped to photograph every single boat.
And if we had, we'd have missed the dolphins. I'd say it worked out rather well.

q: How does the woman feel about missing the earlier ferry?

qGloss.zh: 没赶上早一班渡轮，女士是怎么看的？

opts: It was a relief to the man
It was a pity about the photos
It turned out to be a good thing

audio.text: Have you heard back about the funding?
Not officially. But the director stopped me this morning and asked how many people I'd need on my team next year.

q: What does the man think?
opts: His team will be smaller next year
The director forgot about his request
His request has probably been approved

audio.text: I was told the report had to be ten pages, so I cut half of my analysis.
Ten pages? That limit was dropped last year. Nobody would have minded twenty.

q: What do we learn from the conversation?

qGloss.zh: 从对话中我们知道了什么？

opts: The man shortened his report for nothing
The woman thinks the report is too long
The limit has been raised to twenty pages
The man ignored the page limit

audio.text: How's the new assistant doing?
Put it this way: last week she spotted an error that three of us had missed for a year.

q: What does the man think of the new assistant?

qGloss.zh: 男士觉得新助理怎么样？

opts: She has learned the job slowly

audio.text: You're not wearing the watch I gave you.
It's being repaired. The strap came loose within a couple of days. Even so, it's the most thoughtful present anyone has given me in years.

q: What does the woman want the man to understand?

qGloss.zh: 女士想让男士明白什么？

opts: She would like a different present
She is glad the watch was easy to fix
She loves the watch despite the fault
She thinks the watch was badly chosen

audio.text: The committee described your proposal as ambitious.
Which, in committee language, is generally a euphemism for unlikely to be funded.
Not necessarily. The very same word was applied to the bridge project, and that sailed through within a month.

q: What point is the woman making?
opts: The proposal will certainly be rejected
The bridge project was too ambitious
The word need not be a bad sign

audio.text: I gather the talks between the two companies have slowed down.
Slowed down is generous. Neither side has returned the other's calls in a month, though officially both remain fully committed.

q: What does the woman imply?

qGloss.zh: 女士的言外之意是什么？

opts: The talks are going better than reported
The talks have effectively come to a stop
Both sides are working hard in private
The companies have reached an agreement

audio.text: Rarely has a study attracted so much attention on the strength of so little data. Twelve volunteers, observed for a single weekend, hardly justify headlines announcing a revolution in how we sleep.

q: What is the speaker's attitude to the study?

qGloss.zh: 说话人对这项研究持什么态度？

audio.text: Had the architect been consulted at the outset, we wouldn't now be tearing out a staircase that was finished only last month.
With respect, he was consulted. His advice was simply filed away.

q: What does the man imply?

qGloss.zh: 男士的言外之意是什么？

opts: The staircase was the architect's idea

audio.text: What did you make of the new director's first speech?
It was polished, I'll give her that. Whether there was anything underneath the polish is another matter.

q: What is the woman's view of the speech?

qGloss.zh: 女士对这次讲话的看法是什么？

opts: Too detailed for her to follow

audio.text: I'd hesitate to call the launch a failure.
So would I, were it not for the fact that we sold forty units against a forecast of four thousand.

q: What is the man's opinion of the launch?

qGloss.zh: 男士对这次发布的看法是什么？

opts: It is too early to judge
It was better than it looked

audio.text: Your article argues that remote teams are every bit as creative as those sharing an office.
What it argues is that the evidence to the contrary is weaker than commonly supposed. That is a rather more modest claim.

q: What is the woman doing?
opts: Claiming more than the man suggested
Correcting an overstatement of her view
Admitting that her article was wrong

audio.text: It is not that the city lacks green space. What it lacks is green space within walking distance of the people who most need it. The grand parks on the western edge mainly serve those who already have gardens.

q: What is the speaker's main point?

qGloss.zh: 说话人的主要观点是什么？

opts: The parks are in the wrong places
The city needs far more parkland
The western parks are poorly kept
Private gardens should be opened up

audio.text: Did the editor like your draft?
He said he wouldn't change a word of the first paragraph.
And the rest?
He was less specific, though he did ask how attached I was to it.

q: What can be inferred about the editor?

qGloss.zh: 关于编辑，可以推断出什么？

opts: He has only read the first paragraph
He wants most of the draft changed
He prefers the ending to the opening
He approved the draft as it stands

audio.text: I take it you expect a formal apology to the whole team.
What I expect is for the figures to be right next time. Contrition that changes nothing is hardly worth the breath.

q: What matters most to the woman?

qGloss.zh: 对女士来说什么最重要？

opts: That the man says sorry in public
That the team hears the truth
That the error is not repeated

audio.text: Not until the final chapter does the author reveal who has been telling the story.
And by then, frankly, I had stopped caring. Three hundred pages is a long time to be kept in the dark for the sake of one twist.

q: What is the man's opinion of the book?

qGloss.zh: 男士对这本书的看法是什么？

opts: The final chapter was the weakest part
The book deserved to be far longer
The late surprise was not worth the wait

audio.text: The supplier maintains that the delay is negligible.
Negligible to them, perhaps. To a bakery that has undertaken to deliver two hundred cakes by Saturday, three days is anything but.

q: What is the woman's point?
opts: Three days is a short time to wait
The bakery promised too many cakes
The delay is serious for the bakery
The supplier has lied about the delay

audio.text: You've been conspicuously silent on the redesign.
I was raised to hold my tongue when I had nothing complimentary to offer.

q: What does the man think of the redesign?

qGloss.zh: 男士对新设计的看法是什么？

audio.text: Little did the founders know that the festival would outgrow the village within three years. What began as forty local families sharing soup now draws crowds that the single road in simply cannot carry.

q: What problem does the speaker describe?

qGloss.zh: 说话人描述了什么问题？

opts: The event has become too big for its setting
Fewer local families attend each year
The founders have lost interest in the festival
The road to the village has been closed

audio.text: I take it the client was pleased with the prototype?
Pleased enough to ask how soon we could turn out fifty more. Not so pleased, apparently, as to pay the deposit they pledged in June.

q: What does the man imply about the client?

qGloss.zh: 关于客户，男士暗示了什么？

opts: They paid earlier than they had promised
They found serious faults in the prototype
They have withdrawn the larger order
Their interest has not led to payment

audio.text: Would you say the training was worthwhile?
It confirmed a great deal of what I already knew, at half the speed I would have liked. The lunch, on the other hand, was excellent.

q: What is the woman's overall view of the training?

qGloss.zh: 女士对这次培训的总体看法是什么？

opts: It moved too quickly for her

audio.text: I can't see why the staff took the announcement so badly. There was nothing in it they hadn't been told before.
Had it come a week later, once the new contracts were signed, I doubt anyone would have blinked.

q: According to the man, what upset the staff?

qGloss.zh: 按照男士的说法，是什么让员工不满？

opts: The terms of the new contracts
The way the news was worded

audio.text: I notice my chapter went unmentioned in your review.
I made a point of mentioning every chapter I could recommend in good conscience.

q: What does the woman imply?

qGloss.zh: 女士的言外之意是什么？

opts: She did not think his chapter was good
She forgot to read his chapter
She ran out of space in the review
